title: Вода для кота
purpose: Иллюстрации к согласованной новой редакции. Связаны с редакторским черновиком; исходные иллюстрации сохранены.
frames: Петя набирает воду из крана в прозрачный стакан.
Кот пьёт воду из синей миски. Петя держит пустой стакан после переливания.
prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / illustration-story.
Asset type: two-panel educational illustration for the Russian micro-story "Вода для кота" (Water for the cat).
Edit target and identity/style reference: the provided image of Petya and an orange cat. Replace its feeding story with the following water story. Preserve the same boy's recognizable face, brown eyes, thick curly dark brown hair, green short-sleeved T-shirt, charcoal-grey trousers and blue sneakers, and the exact same orange tabby cat with white chest and white paws. Match the existing polished, warm, softly shaded children's book illustration style and realistic object relationships.
Keep the overall 2:1 landscape canvas, split exactly at its center into TWO EQUAL SQUARE scenes, side by side. Each square must be a complete self-contained composition with important content inside its central 90%, suitable for separate square cropping. No gutter, no dividing line, no frame, no rounded corner baked into the image, no captions, words, letters, numbers, logos, decorative symbols or watermarks. Normal opaque light background.
Story, for semantic guidance only (DO NOT render any text):
Petya notices that the cat's bowl has no water. Petya takes a drinking glass. Petya fills the glass with water from the tap. Petya pours the water from the glass into the bowl. The cat starts drinking water from the bowl.
LEFT SQUARE — the source of the water: In a calm light kitchen with pale cream cupboards and the same warm light wood floor, Petya stands at a low, comfortably reachable sink. Show his face in three-quarter view and his complete figure, his hands, a plain small transparent cylindrical drinking glass WITHOUT A HANDLE and the faucet clearly. Petya is holding this glass directly under the faucet: one thin stream of clean transparent water is visibly going INTO THE OPEN TOP of the glass, which is half full. The glass must remain recognizable as a normal drinking glass, not a cup, mug, bottle, pitcher or watering can. Faucet, glass and boy's hands must not be hidden or ambiguously overlap. Minimal kitchen background. No other person, no extra narrative moment.
RIGHT SQUARE — the result after pouring: The very same Petya kneels on the same kitchen floor next to the same orange cat and the same blue pet bowl from the reference. The cat is visibly DRINKING CLEAR WATER from the blue bowl, muzzle close to the surface, small tongue and subtle ripples. Petya is holding the SAME NOW EMPTY transparent drinking glass upright after pouring the water; its transparency and absence of water should be clear. He watches the cat calmly. Show his complete kneeling figure, hands, empty glass, cat including all paws and tail, and bowl of water, all comfortably inside the square. This is ONE instant AFTER pouring; no pouring stream and no simultaneous repeated stages.
Critical invariants: SAME boy and SAME cat in both panels / source reference. SAME single plain glass used across the panels. SAME blue bowl as reference, with transparent water in the right panel. Remove ALL dry kibble, pet food, bags, packets and food packaging from BOTH panels. No milk, no colored drink, no liquid spills, no duplicate glass or duplicate child, no floating objects. Keep actions and key objects large and easy to read, background sparse. Do not add story actions or emotions beyond the supplied story.
